in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'lei' (to be lofty) and 'anah' (grace, favor) - God's lofty grace.

in_greek.name: Λιαν
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'lios' (graceful) and 'aner' (man) - graceful man.

in_latin.name: Lianus
